products.sourceTitle: KIKI DE MONTPARNASSE La Sirene one-shoulder cutout swimsuit
products.name: KIKI DE MONTPARNASSE La Sirene one-shoulder cutout swimsuit
products.description:
Editors’ Notes

Kiki de Montparnasse' 'La Sirene' swimsuit is designed with bold cutouts meant to resemble a coiled snake. Cut from smooth stretch fabric, it has a one-shoulder neckline and thong briefs.

Size & Fit

• Fits true to size, take your normal size
• Those with a long torso may wish to take the next size up
• High-cut style with minimal brief coverage
• Model is 177cm/ 5'10", bra size 32C and is wearing a size Small

Model measurements:
• Bust: 79cm/ 31"
• Waist: 66cm/ 26"
• Hip: 89cm/ 35"

Details & Care

• Black stretch-polyamide
• Pulls on
• 75% polyamide, 25% elastane
• Hand wash
• Lotion, sunscreen, oil and chlorine can cause discoloration of this item; this is not a manufacturing defect. Please follow care instructions to keep your swimwear in the best condition
products.imageAlt: KIKI DE MONTPARNASSE La Sirene black cutout swimsuit on a forward-facing model

products.sourceTitle: Cut Out Plunge One Piece
products.name: Cut Out Plunge One Piece
products.description:
The ML Separates Plunge Cut out One Piece makes a summer statement with skin revealing cut away sides and a deep V neckline. This suit is a one piece from the front and bikini from behind.

• Adjustable fine straps
• M&L clip back
• High cut leg height and cut away bottom coverage
• Fully lined in our Recycled Body Sculpting silky touch lining

Fit & Sizing

Our model is wearing a size 10 surf suit. She is 177cm, has an 81cm bust, 92cm hips, and a 63cm waist and could wear either an 8 or 10.

Fabric & Care

Exclusive Main Fabric: 85% Recycled Nylon, 15% Elastane
Exclusive Lining: 85% Recycled Nylon, 15% Elastane

To ensure correct care, please refer to the individual instructions on each product. Rinse your swimwear after use. Cold gentle machine wash separately or hand wash with lukewarm water using mild detergent. Dry in shade.
